name: Armor protection, toughness and shields
note: Armor's points, toughness and netherite's knockback resistance (the double 0.1: client/ench_combat) as attribute modifiers of each armor slot, as both official servers send them; damage armor reduces (not in the bypasses_armor damage type tag: fire, lava, magma blocks, cacti and sweet berry bushes so far) is reduced by the documented formula, to the float as both official servers reduce it, and wears each piece worn by a quarter of it, at least one (netherite not by fire; less the points its unbreaking spares: client/ench_unbreaking), through the rules at the next tick, breaking it at its durability; shields raised from either hand block players' attacks from the half their holder faces once raised 5 ticks (minecraft.wiki; recorded: 2 not, 12 blocking): no damage, 1.21.8's block sound or 1.21.4's entity event 29, the hurt sound for others, the shield worn by 1 and the damage from 3, less the points its unbreaking spares (minecraft.wiki; recorded: 6 and 9 worn, 1 not; unbreaking: client/ench_unbreaking), the holder knocked 0.5 towards the attacker then 0.4 away (told to the others only), the hurt cooldown started as by a hurt of nothing, the attack failing; axes disable them for 100 ticks (the cooldown, 1.21.8's break sound and damage event or 1.21.4's entity events 30 and 29, lowered); 1.21.8 knocks a holder hit from behind 0.5 towards the attacker first; the equip sound of a shield put into the off hand
deviations: a piece broken by a hurt's wear gives its slot's break event to the player and those who see them (client/ench_curses: a helmet); several broken in one hurt go from the feet up (not recorded); a piece broken by thorns' wear, and tools', weapons' and shields' breaking, give no event, and the unbreakable component is not honored

shields block only players' attacks (not projectiles, explosions or mobs), every shield as the shield item (1.21.8's blocks_attacks component of a stack is not read), and the block and break sounds' pitch is Circuit's own draw
weak and critical hits on a raised shield, axes other than the iron axe, sweeps reaching a raised shield, the block and break sounds' range and a raised shield at death were not recorded
